_readme: Homepage hero media slot. While poster and video are null the page shows an art-directed placeholder (no furniture). To install the finished Sigma I006/I007 cinematic: drop the files in redesign/luxe/media/hero/, fill in the fields below, and the page renders the poster server-side (fast LCP, no layout shift) and loads the video lazily after the page is interactive. Video is skipped for reduced-motion and data-saver users, who see the poster only. Provide a portrait (9:16) cut under video.mobile / poster.mobile for phones.
label: Sigma I006/I007
